text: Objectives:Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine as well as the fundamental skills on medical treatment and disease-prevention. These medical professionals should undertake medical treatments, disease-prevention, teaching and research in health and medical communities, colleges and research institutions. Core Disciplines:Basic Medicine & Clinical Medicine Major Courses:Histoembryology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, Preventive Medicine, Medical Immunology, Physical Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Gynemetrics, Paediatrics, Laboratory Diagnosis, Medical Iconography, Surgery Pandect, Epidemiology, Functional Experiment, Pathophysiology, Systematic Anatomy, Medical Microbiology Degree Awarded:Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation:Graduates are supposed to undertake research, teaching, management and clinical treatment in medical organizations, research institutions and medical schools at all levels.
